title: Associated-sheaf chart data for an integer-graded polynomial module
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S=k[T_0,T_1]$ and $P=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ with its homogeneous-submodule total-degree grading [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Let $A$ be an integer-graded $S$-module with internal grading $\mathcal G$ and $S_n\mathcal G_j\subseteq\mathcal G_{n+j}$. There exists an associated module sheaf $E$ [lem-weil-pbc-proj-graded-module-sheaf-exists] with injective additive maps from its sections on every positive homogeneous standard open into $A_f$, whose images are the degree-zero fractions. These maps respect the chart ring action and restriction along each homogeneous relation $g^e=af$, sending $y/f^m$ to $a^my/g^{em}$.

source.place: Definition 27.8.3 (01M6), construction preceding it; Lemma 27.8.4 (01M7), clauses (2),(3),(5) and final paragraph

proof.text: Present the polynomial homogeneous pieces as their underlying additive subgroups H. Their subtype groups and graded-ring operations are definitionally the same, so construct GradedRing H from MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra and apply gradedModuleSheaf_exists H to G and hsmul. Obtain Z with the degreeZeroFractions carrier, rho and its fraction formula, and F with chart additive equivalences and scalar and restriction compatibility.

Construct the identity graded ring homomorphism phi from homogeneousSubmodule to H. HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le and mem_irrelevant_of_mem show the irrelevant-ideal inclusion needed by Mathlib Proj.map phi. Push F forward along this concrete morphism using Scheme.Modules.pushforward. Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen is definitional, so the old chart groups and additive equivalences are also the new ones. Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE identifies the new scalar action with the old action after Away.map phi; on fraction representatives Away.map_mk and Away.val_mk show the ordinary localization values are unchanged. Pushforward restriction is definitionally the original restriction, with inclusion proofs identified by proof irrelevance. This is the proved private helper graded_module_chart_regrading; no scheme-isomorphism theorem is assumed.

Compose each transported additive equivalence with Z.subtype.toAddMonoidHom. Injectivity follows by composing the equivalence injectivity with Subtype.val_injective. The proved helper range_chart_inclusion shows that the composite range equals the carrier of Z, then hZ identifies this carrier with degreeZeroFractions. The transported ambient scalar equation is precisely the required equation. For the given relation g^e=a*f, basicOpen_pow and basicOpen_mul show D_H(g) is contained in D_H(f), directly and without standardOpenProperties. Apply the transported restriction equation, then compose its Subtype.val image with the fraction formula of rho supplied by gradedModuleSheaf_exists.

proof_origin.place: Construction before Definition 01M6 and Lemma 01M7; implemented using Mathlib Proj.map and Scheme.Modules.pushforward, followed by chart inclusion; B3 stage-3 proof, 2026-10-12

lean.statement:
theorem graded_module_chart_data_exists (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (A : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (𝒢 : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (h𝒢 : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝒢)
    (hsmul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (s : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (x : A),
      s ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → x ∈ 𝒢 j → s • x ∈ 𝒢 ((n : ℤ) + j)) :
    ∃ E : (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Modules,
    ∃ (alpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ),
      0 < d → f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d →
      E.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)) →+
        LocalizedModule.Away f A),
      (∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d),
        Function.Injective (alpha f d hd hf) ∧
        Set.range (alpha f d hd hf) = degreeZeroFractions
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝒢 n : Set A)) (Submonoid.powers f)) ∧
      (∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (r : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (s : E.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
        alpha f d hd hf (awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f r • s) =
          algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
            (Localization.Away f) r • alpha f d hd hf s) ∧
      (∀ (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d b : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hb : 0 < b)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (hg : g ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k b)
        (inc : basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) g ≤
          basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (e c : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
        0 < e → a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k c → g ^ e = a * f →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : A)
          (s : E.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
          alpha f d hd hf s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
          alpha g b hb hg (E.val.map (homOfLE inc).op s) =
            mk (a ^ m • y) (⟨g ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g))
